```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(leaflet)
library(echarts4r)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(readxl)
library(htmltools)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(crosstalk)

# Keep the source workbook unchanged; translate its fields for display.
weather <- read_excel("weather_data(2020).xlsx", sheet = "데이터") |>
  rename(
    StationID = `번호`, Station = `관측소`, Item = `항목`,
    Annual = `연평균`
  ) |>
  rename_with(~ month.abb, all_of(paste0(1:12, "월")))

station_names <- c(
  "서울" = "Seoul", "인천" = "Incheon", "양평" = "Yangpyeong",
  "대관령" = "Daegwallyeong", "강릉" = "Gangneung", "서산" = "Seosan",
  "대전" = "Daejeon", "청주" = "Cheongju", "전주" = "Jeonju",
  "광주" = "Gwangju", "목포" = "Mokpo", "대구" = "Daegu",
  "울산" = "Ulsan", "부산" = "Busan", "제주" = "Jeju",
  "서귀포" = "Seogwipo", "울릉도" = "Ulleungdo"
)
weather$Station <- unname(station_names[weather$Station])
stopifnot(!anyNA(weather$Station))

temp_data <- weather |> filter(Item == "평균 기온 (℃)")
prec_data <- weather |> filter(Item == "강수량 (㎜)")
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(temp_data$StationID),
  !anyDuplicated(prec_data$StationID),
  setequal(temp_data$StationID, prec_data$StationID)
)

# Rebuild the original dual-axis popup charts with English labels.
# Save shared JavaScript dependencies once, beside the generated charts.
popup_dir <- file.path("contents", "climate-stations-en")
dir.create(popup_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(temp_data))) {
  station <- temp_data$Station[i]
  rainfall <- prec_data |> filter(StationID == temp_data$StationID[i])
  monthly <- data.frame(
    Month = month.abb,
    Temperature = as.numeric(unlist(temp_data[i, month.abb], use.names = FALSE)),
    Precipitation = as.numeric(unlist(rainfall[1, month.abb], use.names = FALSE))
  )

  chart <- monthly |>
    e_charts(Month, width = "100%", height = 400) |>
    e_line(Temperature, name = "Mean temperature (°C)",
           y_index = 0, color = "#EEA47F") |>
    e_bar(Precipitation, name = "Precipitation (mm)",
          y_index = 1, color = "#00539C", opacity = 0.6) |>
    e_title(text = station, left = "center") |>
    e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>
    e_grid(top = 75, bottom = 75, left = 50, right = 50) |>
    e_x_axis(axisLabel = list(fontSize = 12),
             axisTick = list(show = FALSE),
             # Draw the baseline at the bottom (-15°C), rather than at zero.
             axisLine = list(show = TRUE, onZero = FALSE,
                             lineStyle = list(color = "black", width = 1.5))) |>
    e_y_axis(index = 0, name = "Temperature (°C)", min = -15, max = 35,
             interval = 5,
             axisLabel = list(fontSize = 12, showMinLabel = TRUE,
                              showMaxLabel = TRUE, hideOverlap = FALSE)) |>
    e_y_axis(index = 1, name = "Precipitation (mm)", min = 0, max = 500,
             splitLine = list(show = FALSE),
             axisLabel = list(fontSize = 12)) |>
    e_legend(bottom = 8, textStyle = list(fontSize = 12))

  saveWidget(
    chart,
    file = file.path(popup_dir, paste0(tolower(station), ".html")),
    selfcontained = FALSE, libdir = "lib",
    title = paste(station, "- Monthly Climate Normals (1991-2020)")
  )
}

popup_html <- function(station) {
  as.character(tags$iframe(
    src = paste0("contents/climate-stations-en/", tolower(station), ".html"),
    title = paste(station, "monthly temperature and precipitation"),
    loading = "lazy",
    style = "width: min(600px, 72vw); height: 400px; border: 0;"
  ))
}

prepare_stations <- function(data) {
  data |>
    mutate(
      StationID = as.character(StationID),
      # Named vectors serialize as JSON objects; Leaflet needs an array.
      Popup = unname(vapply(Station, popup_html, character(1)))
    ) |>
    select(StationID, Station, all_of(month.abb), Annual,
           Longitude, Latitude, Popup)
}
temp_data <- prepare_stations(temp_data)
prec_data <- prepare_stations(prec_data)

# Separate groups keep the two measurements' filters independent.
# Explicit station keys keep map markers and table rows aligned.
shared_temp <- SharedData$new(temp_data, key = ~StationID,
                              group = "temperature-stations")
shared_prec <- SharedData$new(prec_data, key = ~StationID,
                              group = "precipitation-stations")

station_map <- function(shared_data, numbered = FALSE) {
  map <- leaflet(shared_data) |>
    addTiles(group = "OpenStreetMap") |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap, group = "OpenTopoMap") |>
    hideGroup("OpenTopoMap")

  if (numbered) {
    map <- map |>
      addCircleMarkers(
        ~Longitude, ~Latitude, group = "Stations", layerId = ~StationID,
        radius = 10, weight = 1, color = "#00539C",
        fillOpacity = 0.8, fillColor = "#00539C",
        popup = ~Popup, popupOptions = popupOptions(maxWidth = 650),
        # Attach the number to this marker rather than registering another
        # Crosstalk layer with the same key (Leaflet 2.2.3 cannot filter that).
        label = ~StationID,
        labelOptions = labelOptions(
          noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, textsize = "14px",
          direction = "center",
          style = list(color = "white", "text-shadow" = "0 0 3px black")
        )
      )
  } else {
    map <- map |>
      addMarkers(
        ~Longitude, ~Latitude, group = "Stations", layerId = ~StationID,
        popup = ~Popup, popupOptions = popupOptions(maxWidth = 650),
        label = ~Station
      )
  }

  map |>
    fitBounds(
      min(temp_data$Longitude), min(temp_data$Latitude),
      max(temp_data$Longitude), max(temp_data$Latitude)
    ) |>
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = c("OpenStreetMap", "OpenTopoMap"),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = TRUE)
    )
}

station_table <- function(shared_data, annual_label) {
  fields <- names(shared_data$origData())
  headers <- fields
  headers[fields == "Annual"] <- annual_label
  hidden <- match(c("StationID", "Longitude", "Latitude", "Popup"), fields) - 1L

  datatable(
    shared_data, rownames = FALSE, colnames = headers,
    class = "compact stripe hover", selection = "single",
    options = list(
      dom = "fti", paging = FALSE, order = list(),
      scrollX = TRUE, scrollY = "55vh", scrollCollapse = TRUE,
      columnDefs = list(list(visible = FALSE, targets = hidden)),
      language = list(search = "Search stations:")
    )
  ) |>
    formatRound(columns = c(month.abb, "Annual"), digits = 1) |>
    formatStyle(columns = fields, fontSize = "80%")
}
```

# Regional Climate of South Korea {.sidebar width="330px"}

### Regional climate characteristics

#### 1) Climate normals

Climate normals are **averages over a 30-year period ending in a year that ends in zero**.

For example, the 2020 climate normals summarize temperature, precipitation, and other observations for **1991–2020**. They are usually updated every 10 years.

#### 2) South Korea's climate (2020 normals)

- Mean temperature: **12.8°C**
- Annual precipitation: **1,306.3 mm**

#### 3) Changes reported in the original source

- Temperature increased by **0.3°C** compared with 10 years earlier and **0.5°C** compared with 20 years earlier.
- Precipitation increased by **34.1 mm** compared with 10 years earlier, but decreased by **25.0 mm** compared with 20 years earlier.

#### 4) Compare stations with the national averages

Adjust the annual ranges to filter the map and table on the corresponding tab. Click a station marker to view its monthly climate chart.

```{r}
filter_slider(
  id = "annual-temperature", label = "Annual mean temperature (°C)",
  sharedData = shared_temp, column = ~Annual,
  step = 0.1, round = FALSE, sep = "", ticks = FALSE
)

filter_slider(
  id = "annual-precipitation", label = "Annual precipitation (mm)",
  sharedData = shared_prec, column = ~Annual,
  step = 0.1, round = FALSE, sep = "", ticks = FALSE
)
```

Source: Korea Meteorological Administration, *Meteorological Observation Statistics*, station climate normals, December 2020. Accessed November 11, 2024, as cited in the original dashboard. [View the source table on KOSIS](https://kosis.kr/statHtml/statHtml.do?orgId=141&tblId=DT_14102_B002&conn_path=I2).
